judgement.reason: The application source for the API and frontend lives only in git submodules, which are absent from the source archive, so this repository has no buildable application.

reviews.findingEvidence: Durable local filesystem state declared: VOLUME /data (docker/Dockerfile), volume lago_redis_data:/data (docker-compose.yml redis), volume lago_storage_data:/app/storage (docker-compose.yml api), volume lago_storage_data:/app/storage (docker-compose.yml api-worker)
reviews.reason: The production Dockerfile declares VOLUME /data and installs postgresql-17 and redis-server inside the image, and the shown compose defaults LAGO_USE_AWS_S3 to false, so no shown line proves that the app keeps no durable data on local disk.
